WatchHome.unmutePreview: Whakakā te oro o te arokite

WatchFooter.newsletter: Tāpare atu ki tā mātou pānui
WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: Te whakamahi AI me te whakamārama i te pūtake
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Ko te whakamahi a ngā pūnaha māturanga horihori i ngā mōhiohio mai i tēnei whārangi me whai whakamārama i te pūtake. Me tautuhi tētahi kaihoko AI, tauira reo nui (LLM), pūkaha rapu AI, kaikōkiri (crawler), rānei tētahi pūnaha aunoa ōrite e tango ana, e whakamahi ana rānei i ngā mōhiohio mai i tēnei whārangi mō te whakangungu, te tiki, te hanga whakautu, ngā ratonga rānei ka tukuna ki ngā kaiwhakamahi, ki ngā kiritaki rānei, i a Jesus Film Project hei pūtake, ā, me whakauru hoki he hononga mārama, tika atu ki tēnei whārangi i ngā wā katoa e whakamahia ana, e whakaaturia ana rānei aua mōhiohio. Tirohia ā mātou <terms>Tikanga Whakamahi</terms>.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Hangaia mō ngā mīhana o te ao
WatchHomePromo.title: E kore te karere e rerekē. Ko te ara mātakitaki a te tangata ka rerekē.
WatchHomePromo.description: Kei te hanga anō mātou i tā mātou whare ataata me ngā taputapu mai i te tīmatanga, e whakapau ana i ngā tekau tau o te mahi whakamāori ki ngā tūāpapa e huihui, e mātakitaki, e tiritiri ai te tangata.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Te whare kiriata tino nui rawa o te ao mō ngā whakamāoritanga
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Nā ngā tekau tau o te mahi whakamāori, i kawea e ngā hoa minita pono, i hanga he whare kōpaki me ngā mano tini ara reo kia tūtaki ai te tangata ki te kōrero mō Hēhu i te reo e tino pā ana ki a rātou.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Te kawe i ngā reo pono ki ngā hōputu hōu
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Kei te hanga anō mātou i te āhua o te kōrerotanga ā-ataata o ngā kōrero Rongopai, e hono ana i ngā whakamāoritanga pono ki ngā hōputu hou kia taea ai te neke noa o te karere puta noa i ngā tūāpapa, ngā ahurea, me ngā mata.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Nui atu i te whare kōpaki. He rōpū aronga-ngaio ki te mīhana.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: He rōpū ao a Jesus Film Project o ngā kaiwhakamāori, ngā tohunga pāpāho, ngā ētita, me ngā kaihanga e huri ana i ngā tekau tau o te wheako minita hei taputapu mā ngā kaihanga-ākonga i ngā wāhi katoa.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Ko tā mātou e hanga ana ināianei
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Whakapā atu ki ngā kaitirotiro ki ngā whai wāhitanga tūturu i roto i tō rātou haerenga wairua, ā, āwhinatia rātou kia whai i tētahi taahiraa anō ki te hapori, ki te Karaipiture, ki te mīhana rānei.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: He whare pāpāho Karaitiana whānui, me ngā mano tini ataata, kiriata, me ngā rauemi e wātea ana i roto i ngā reo maha mō te minita me te kauwhau puta noa i te ao.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Ngā Utauta Matihiko mā ngā Minita
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Ko te whakahaere ataata, te tohatoha ihirangi, te whai wāhitanga o te hunga whakarongo, me te tātaritanga i hangaia hei āwhina i ngā minita kia toro atu ki te tokomaha ake o te tangata i runga i te whai hua.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Āwhina ki te hanga i <highlight>te reanga panuku</highlight> o ngā taputapu mīhana
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Kei te pōwhiri mātou i ngā kaimahi, ngā kaihanga, me ngā hoa mahi ki te uru wawe. Whakamātauria tuatahi ngā taputapu hou, tuku urupare, ā, āwhina ki te waihanga i ngā hua i hangaia mō te mahi mīhana tūturu.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Tūhuratia tā mātou kohinga ataata me ngā rauemi e whakamāori ana i te Paipera kia ora mā ngā kōrero me ngā whakaakoranga ngahau.
WatchHomeSections.showcaseTitle: E kōrerotia ana te Karaipiture mā te kiriata
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Hono mai ki tā mātou haerenga Aranga Kirihimete mā tētahi ataata ia rā e whakakaha ana i te tūmanako mō te Kirihimete, e torotoro ana i te tumanako, te hari, me te kupu whakaari mō te taenga mai o Ihu.
